blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two sea turtles were found dead, with their carcasses mutilated, on the shore of Barangay Tiguis in Lila, Bohol. READ: Bacnotan, La Union records first sea turtle nest of the season According to the Bohol Provincial Environment Management Office, the dead green sea turtles (scientific name: Chelonia mydas) were discovered on Nov. 18. The office said the first turtle discovered—measuring 45 centimeters (cm) in length and 40 cm in width—had its carcass severely mutilated, with only its head, organs, and tail remaining intact.
